html:
SEA-RAFT (Princeton, 2024): a faster and more accurate successor of RAFT for dense optical flow, needing only 4 refinement steps. BSD-3-Clause code and weights; some training sets are research-only.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: SEA-RAFT: Simple, Efficient, Accurate RAFT for Optical Flow, ECCV 2024, 2024-05-23
  • Original code: https://github.com/princeton-vl/SEA-RAFT at 9137517ba24e
  • Code licence: BSD-3-Clause (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: BSD-3-Clause
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/MemorySlices/Tartan-C-T-TSKH432x960-M/blob/85a47dc9096cca6e907ef9100dc1847a19b26a2a/README.md
  • Training data: TartanAir, FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (TartanAir pretraining, FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D (part of SceneFlow), then a mix of FlyingThings3D, Sintel, KITTI 2015 and HD1K (TSKH))
    • sea-raft-m-kitti: TartanAir, FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (TartanAir, FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, the TSKH mix, then fine-tuned on KITTI 2015)
    • sea-raft-m-spring: TartanAir, FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark, Spring (scene flow / optical flow / stereo, University of Stuttgart) (TartanAir, FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, the TSKH mix, then fine-tuned on Spring)
    • sea-raft-m-things: TartanAir, FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa) (TartanAir, FlyingChairs, then FlyingThings3D (part of SceneFlow))
    • sea-raft-s-kitti: TartanAir, FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (TartanAir, FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, the TSKH mix, then fine-tuned on KITTI 2015)
    • sea-raft-s-spring: TartanAir, FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark, Spring (scene flow / optical flow / stereo, University of Stuttgart) (TartanAir, FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, the TSKH mix, then fine-tuned on Spring)
  • Options: iters = 4 (>= 1)
  • Kernel libraries: raft_flow, cutlass_conv, cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: sea-raft-m, sea-raft-m-kitti, sea-raft-m-spring, sea-raft-m-things, sea-raft-s, sea-raft-s-kitti, sea-raft-s-spring
  • Outputs: flow
  • Input size:
    • sea-raft-m, sea-raft-m-kitti, sea-raft-m-things, sea-raft-s, sea-raft-s-kitti: any H x W >= 128, padded to a multiple of 8
    • sea-raft-m-spring, sea-raft-s-spring: any H x W >= 256, padded to a multiple of 8
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): sea-raft-m 1024x2048 (8.3 GiB peak allocated, 9.4 reserved); sea-raft-m-kitti 1024x2048 (8.3 GiB peak allocated, 9.4 reserved); sea-raft-m-spring 1988x2880 (4.1 GiB peak allocated, 4.8 reserved); sea-raft-m-things 1024x2048 (8.3 GiB peak allocated, 9.4 reserved); sea-raft-s 1024x2048 (8.3 GiB peak allocated, 9.3 reserved); sea-raft-s-kitti 1024x2048 (8.3 GiB peak allocated, 9.3 reserved); sea-raft-s-spring 1988x2880 (4.1 GiB peak allocated, 4.8 reserved)
  • sea-raft-m 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 34 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 70 s (ONNX + engine).
  • sea-raft-m-kitti 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 35 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 70 s (ONNX + engine).
  • sea-raft-m-spring 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 23 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 47 s (ONNX + engine).
  • sea-raft-m-things 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 35 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 74 s (ONNX + engine).

  • sea-raft-s-spring 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 22 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 39 s (ONNX + engine).

Measured

Frames _10 -> _11 at full size against the flow_occ ground truth; EPE = mean of the per-pair mean end-point error, Fl-all = share of all valid pixels with an error > 3 px and > 5 % of the GT magnitude. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
